priorityList: Maintain Virulent Plague on all targets using Outbreak.
Cast Death and Decay (or Desecrate) if it is not currently active on the ground.
Cast Army of the Dead when your major cooldowns are ready or during Festering Scythe windows.
Cast Dark Transformation as often as possible, ideally synced with Army of the Dead.
Use on-use trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Dark Transformation or while your Ghoul Army is active.
Cast Soul Reaper on targets below 35% health.
Cast Putrefy if you are at max charges or if Dark Transformation has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Festering Strike if Festering Scythe is talented and needs to be applied or is about to expire.
Cast Epidemic to spend Runic Power if you have a Sudden Doom proc or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready to build resources.
Cast Scourge Strike (or Clawing Shadows) if you have 1 or more stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready to summon San'layn ghouls.
Cast Putrefy as a priority filler to consume charges.
Cast Epidemic as your primary Runic Power spender in AoE situations (4+ targets).
Cast Death Coil only if there are fewer than 4 targets and you need to spend Runic Power.
